-- recovers the top.
instantiateRecordUpdate : ModuleCtx ->
  String ->
  RecordInfo ->
  List String ->
  (RecordSubst, Mono)
instantiateRecordUpdate mctx rname (RecordInfo paramIds authIds result fields _) assigned =
  let subst = freshSubst mctx paramIds
  let cells = recordAuthCells authIds result fields
  let asub =
    map
      (id => (
        id,
        updateAuthority mctx rname fields assigned id (IdMap.get id cells),
      ))
      authIds
  (RecordSubst subst asub, substMono mctx.mcGraph subst [] asub result)

updateAuthority : ModuleCtx ->
  String ->
  List (String, Mono) ->
  List String ->
  Int ->
  Option (Ref Authvar) ->
  Authority
updateAuthority mctx rname fields assigned id source
  | IdMap.has id mctx.mcGraph.graphRun.ctorExistentialsRef.value =
    let mentioning =
      map fst (filterList (f => IdMap.has id (authCellsIn (snd f) Tip)) fields)
    let replaced = filterList (n => contains n assigned) mentioning
    if isEmptyL replaced then
      sharedAuthority mctx id source
    else if listLen replaced == listLen mentioning then
      AVar (freshInferenceAuthvar mctx id source)
    else
      let _ =
        pushTypeError
          mctx
          "T-AUTHORITY-EXISTENTIAL-SCOPE"
          (partialExistentialUpdateMsg rname mentioning)
      AVar (freshInferenceAuthvar mctx id source)
  | otherwise = AVar (freshInferenceAuthvar mctx id source)

-- A universal freshens flexible, as at any use.  An existential binder is
-- opened only by a pattern; a field read or update sees the value without
-- opening it, so what it recovers is the domain's top: the value proves
-- nothing about an authority the read cannot name.
sharedAuthority : ModuleCtx -> Int -> Option (Ref Authvar) -> Authority
sharedAuthority mctx id source
  | IdMap.has id mctx.mcGraph.graphRun.ctorExistentialsRef.value = match source
    Some cell => authTop (authvarDomain cell)
    None => authTop PUnit
  | otherwise = AVar (freshInferenceAuthvar mctx id source)

substRecordField : GraphCtx -> RecordSubst -> Mono -> Mono
substRecordField gctx (RecordSubst subst asub) fm =
  substMono gctx subst [] asub fm

recordFieldMap : RecordInfo -> OrdMap Mono
recordFieldMap (RecordInfo _ _ _ _ idx) = idx

recordFieldNames : RecordInfo -> List String
recordFieldNames (RecordInfo _ _ _ fields _) = map fst fields

substField : GraphCtx ->
  List (Int, Mono) ->
  List (Int, Authority) ->
  (String, Mono) ->
  (String, Mono)
substField gctx subst asub (fn, fm) = (fn, substMono gctx subst [] asub fm)

-- Publish every top-level function clause and top-level let-group member under
-- the scheme its group generalized to, mirroring the decl shapes `funDefs`
-- flattens.  Each clause of a multi-clause function has its own id and records
-- the one scheme, and whether the module declares a signature for its name.
recordTopBinderTypes : GraphCtx -> OrdMap Scheme -> List Decl -> Unit
recordTopBinderTypes gctx schemes decls =
  let signed = signedTopNames decls omEmpty
  fold (_ d => recordTopDeclBinderTypes gctx schemes signed d) () decls

-- The names a top-level type signature declares, an annotated one included.
signedTopNames : List Decl -> OrdMap Unit -> OrdMap Unit
signedTopNames [] acc = acc
signedTopNames ((DTypeSig _ n _ _) :: rest) acc =
  signedTopNames rest (omInsert n () acc)
signedTopNames ((DAttrib _ d) :: rest) acc = signedTopNames (d :: rest) acc
signedTopNames (_ :: rest) acc = signedTopNames rest acc

recordTopDeclBinderTypes : GraphCtx ->
  OrdMap Scheme ->
  OrdMap Unit ->
  Decl ->
  Unit
recordTopDeclBinderTypes gctx schemes signed (DFunDef _ n ps _ _ bid) =
  recordTopFunBinderType gctx schemes signed n bid (listLen ps)
recordTopDeclBinderTypes gctx schemes signed (DLetGroup _ binds) =
  fold
    (_ b => match b
      LetBind n clauses _ bid => match clauses
        (FunClause ps _) :: _ =>
          recordTopFunBinderType gctx schemes signed n bid (listLen ps)
        [] => recordTopFunBinderType gctx schemes signed n bid 0)
    ()
    binds
recordTopDeclBinderTypes gctx schemes signed (DAttrib _ d) =
  recordTopDeclBinderTypes gctx schemes signed d
recordTopDeclBinderTypes gctx _ _ _ = ()

recordTopFunBinderType : GraphCtx ->
  OrdMap Scheme ->
  OrdMap Unit ->
  String ->
  BinderId ->
  Int ->
  Unit
recordTopFunBinderType gctx schemes signed n bid arity =
  match omLookup n schemes
    Some sch =>
      recordBinderType
        gctx
        bid
        n
        (schemeMono sch)
        (Some arity)
        (omHasKey n signed)
    None => ()

-- True iff the expression is an explicit lambda at the top level.
-- ⚠️ #807 (pre-existing, out of scope here): does NOT see through an ELoc
-- wrapper, so a zero-param `let rec f = x => …` clause — whose RHS the parser
-- wraps in ELoc — is WRONGLY rejected as non-function even though it plainly
-- is one. Confirmed this predates #799's fix (reproduces identically against
-- pre-#799 top-level `let rec`, the only call site old enough to hit it) —
-- not something introduced by the block/expr-level guards added here.
isSyntacticLambda : Expr -> Bool
isSyntacticLambda (ELam _ _) = True
isSyntacticLambda _ = False

-- D2 fix: check all top-level DLetGroup declarations for non-function recursive
-- bindings.  A binding is illegal
-- when ALL its clauses have zero params AND none is a syntactic lambda.
-- Pushes the error into typeErrors for each violating member.
checkLetRecDecls : ModuleCtx -> List Decl -> Unit
checkLetRecDecls mctx [] = ()
checkLetRecDecls mctx ((DLetGroup _ binds) :: rest) =
  let _ = checkLetBinds mctx binds
  checkLetRecDecls mctx rest
checkLetRecDecls mctx (_ :: rest) = checkLetRecDecls mctx rest

checkLetBinds : ModuleCtx -> List LetBind -> Unit
checkLetBinds mctx [] = ()
checkLetBinds mctx ((LetBind name clauses _ _) :: rest) =
  let _ = checkLetBind mctx name clauses
  checkLetBinds mctx rest

checkLetBind : ModuleCtx -> String -> List FunClause -> Unit
checkLetBind mctx name clauses
  | allList clauseIsNonFunction clauses =
    pushTypeError
      (mctxAtIfSome (clausesSpanLoc clauses) mctx)
      "T-NONREC-VALUE-LET"
      (letRecNonFunctionMsg name)
  | otherwise = ()

clauseIsNonFunction : FunClause -> Bool
clauseIsNonFunction (FunClause [] rhs) = not (isSyntacticLambda rhs)
clauseIsNonFunction (FunClause _ _) = False

-- #799: the guard above (checkLetRecDecls/checkLetBind) only walks TOP-LEVEL
-- DLetGroup declarations. BLOCK-level (`let rec x = v` as a DoStmt) and
-- EXPRESSION-level (`let rec x = v in e2`, an ELetGroup) `let rec` reach
-- blockRecLet/inferRecLet/inferLetGroup directly, with no non-function check at
-- all — a non-function binding (e.g. `let rec loop = loop`) silently pre-binds
-- the name to a placeholder Ref and evaluates to it, never erroring.

-- blockRecLet/inferRecLet already have the bound name's (possibly-curried) RHS
-- expr in hand: `curryLam pats e1` for a function-form clause is always an
-- ELam, so this only ever flags the genuinely zero-param, non-lambda case —
-- identical discrimination to clauseIsNonFunction, just on the curried form.
-- Both call sites are ELet, produced ONLY from a singleton binding (a plain
-- `let f a… = e1 [in e2]` or an explicit `let rec` — "with" mutual-grouping was
-- removed), so — unlike ELetGroup below — there is no risk of an innocent
-- bystander binding riding along; mirroring the top-level "not a syntactic
-- lambda ⇒ reject" rule verbatim is safe here. Unlike the top-level call site
-- (which has no expression in hand to locate against), this DOES have the RHS
-- expr and passes it to pushTypeErrorAt via exprLoc (ERROR-QUALITY.md) — but
-- that is a BEST-EFFORT location, not a guaranteed one: exprLoc only recognizes
-- an ELoc/EDoOrigin wrapper, and not every Expr shape the parser produces is
-- wrapped in one (e.g. a bare `EBinOp` RHS like `let rec x = x + 1` has no
-- ELoc, so exprLoc returns None and the diagnostic falls back to the zero
-- range — same as the top-level guard's own unlocated call). A wrapped RHS
-- (the common case — most expressions ARE ELoc-wrapped) gets a real range.
checkRecBindNonFunction : ModuleCtx -> String -> Expr -> Unit
checkRecBindNonFunction mctx name e
  | isSyntacticLambda e = ()
  | otherwise =
    pushTypeErrorAt
      mctx
      "T-NONREC-VALUE-LET"
      (exprLoc e)
      (letRecNonFunctionMsg name)

-- inferLetGroup's ELetGroup is DIFFERENT: it is the SAME node `where` clauses
-- desugar to (parser.mdk whereEol/whereTail/guard-arm-where — verified: no
-- `rec` keyword involved, no AST field distinguishing the two), and a `where`
-- group routinely bundles plain, NON-recursive value helpers alongside real
-- functions (e.g. stdlib/list.mdk's `split`: `where sepLen = length sep; go
-- ys = …` — sepLen never mentions itself or any sibling). Applying
-- checkRecBindNonFunction's blunt "not a lambda ⇒ reject" rule here false-
-- positived on exactly that (confirmed against the tree before landing this).
--
-- So this check is narrower and more precise instead of broader: a zero-param,
-- non-lambda clause is illegal only if its RHS EAGERLY (i.e. not deferred
-- behind a nested lambda) mentions itself or a NOT-YET-INSTALLED sibling — the
-- actual hazard (evalLetGroup pre-binds every member's cell to Ref VUnit and
-- installs each member's value in SOURCE ORDER, so an eager reference to a
-- cell installed BEFORE this one is already set — safe — while a reference to
-- itself or a cell installed AFTER this one reads stale VUnit — unsafe).
--
-- Concretely: for the clause at index i, only a self-or-FORWARD reference
-- (index >= i) is illegal; a BACKWARD reference (index < i) is the ordinary,
-- safe `where`-clause shape (`f x = b where a = x + 1; b = a + 100` — `b`
-- referencing the earlier `a` is fine, `a` referencing the later `b` would not
-- be). checkLetGroupBindsGo threads exactly that suffix: at each step the
-- current binding's own name is prepended to the REST of the list (every
-- sibling that installs after it), so "names" passed down is always "self +
-- forward", never "self + every sibling" — an earlier false-positive this
-- fixed (confirmed against the tree: it rejected working `where`-bound values
-- that only referenced an EARLIER sibling).
checkLetGroupBindsLocated : ModuleCtx -> List LetBind -> Unit
checkLetGroupBindsLocated mctx = checkLetGroupBindsGo mctx

checkLetGroupBindsGo : ModuleCtx -> List LetBind -> Unit
checkLetGroupBindsGo mctx [] = ()
checkLetGroupBindsGo mctx ((LetBind name clauses _ _) :: rest) =
  let selfAndForward = name :: map letBindName rest
  let _ = checkClausesNonFunctionLocated mctx selfAndForward name clauses
  checkLetGroupBindsGo mctx rest

checkClausesNonFunctionLocated : ModuleCtx ->
  List String ->
  String ->
  List FunClause ->
  Unit
checkClausesNonFunctionLocated mctx names name clauses
  | allList clauseIsNonFunction clauses
    && anyClauseEagerlyRefsGroup names clauses =
    pushTypeErrorAt
      mctx
      "T-NONREC-VALUE-LET"
      (clausesLoc clauses)
      (letRecNonFunctionMsg name)
  | otherwise = ()

anyClauseEagerlyRefsGroup : List String -> List FunClause -> Bool
anyClauseEagerlyRefsGroup names clauses =
  anyList (clauseEagerlyRefsGroup names) clauses

clauseEagerlyRefsGroup : List String -> FunClause -> Bool
clauseEagerlyRefsGroup names (FunClause _ rhs) = anyMember names (eagerRefs rhs)

clausesLoc : List FunClause -> Option Loc
clausesLoc [] = None
clausesLoc ((FunClause _ rhs) :: _) = exprLoc rhs

-- The span of the first clause's right-hand side, unwrapped nodes included.
clausesSpanLoc : List FunClause -> Option Loc
clausesSpanLoc [] = None
clausesSpanLoc ((FunClause _ rhs) :: _) = exprSpanLoc rhs

-- Names `e` reads WITHOUT first going under a lambda (a lambda DEFERS
-- evaluation, so a reference inside one cannot observe a still-uninstalled
-- letrec-group cell). Deliberately UNDER-approximates: an Expr shape not
-- explicitly handled falls to the catch-all `[]` (no eager reference
-- detected) rather than guessing — that can only make this check MORE
-- permissive than exhaustive coverage would, never less, so an unhandled
-- shape is a missed catch (no worse than status quo before #799's fix), not a
-- new false positive. Mirrors marker.mdk's collectVars (the DCE reference
-- walk) with ONE change: collectVars descends into ELam bodies (DCE needs
-- every eventually-reachable name); this stops at ELam (its body is deferred,
-- not eager).
eagerRefs : Expr -> List String
eagerRefs (EVar x) = [x]
eagerRefs (EVarId x _) = [x]
-- #2705: a marked occurrence is still a reference to the name (every driver marks
-- before inference now); dropping it here would make this check more permissive
-- than the un-marked tree it mirrors.
eagerRefs (EMethodAt x _ _) = [x]
eagerRefs (EDictAt x _) = [x]
eagerRefs (EApp a b) = eagerRefs a ++ eagerRefs b
eagerRefs (ELam _ _) = []
eagerRefs (ELet _ _ _ e1 e2) = eagerRefs e1 ++ eagerRefs e2
eagerRefs (ELetGroup bs e2) = flatMap eagerRefsLetBind bs ++ eagerRefs e2
eagerRefs (EMatch e0 arms) = eagerRefs e0 ++ flatMap eagerRefsArm arms
eagerRefs (EIf c t el) = eagerRefs c ++ eagerRefs t ++ eagerRefs el
eagerRefs (EBinOp _ a b _) = eagerRefs a ++ eagerRefs b
eagerRefs (EUnOp _ a _) = eagerRefs a
eagerRefs (EInfix op a b) = op :: eagerRefs a ++ eagerRefs b
eagerRefs (EFieldAccess e0 _ _) = eagerRefs e0
eagerRefs (ERecordCreate _ fs) = flatMap eagerRefsFieldAssign fs
eagerRefs (ERecordUpdate e0 fs _) =
  eagerRefs e0 ++ flatMap eagerRefsFieldAssign fs
eagerRefs (EVariantUpdate _ e0 fs) =
  eagerRefs e0 ++ flatMap eagerRefsFieldAssign fs
eagerRefs (EArrayLit es) = flatMap eagerRefs es
eagerRefs (EListLit es) = flatMap eagerRefs es
eagerRefs (ETuple es) = flatMap eagerRefs es
eagerRefs (EIndex e0 i) = eagerRefs e0 ++ eagerRefs i
eagerRefs (ERangeList lo hi _) = eagerRefs lo ++ eagerRefs hi
eagerRefs (ERangeArray lo hi _) = eagerRefs lo ++ eagerRefs hi
eagerRefs (ESlice e0 lo hi _) = eagerRefs e0 ++ eagerRefs lo ++ eagerRefs hi
eagerRefs (EBlock stmts) = flatMap eagerRefsDoStmt stmts
eagerRefs (EDo _ stmts) = flatMap eagerRefsDoStmt stmts
eagerRefs (EAnnot e0 _) = eagerRefs e0
eagerRefs (EHeadAnnot e0 _) = eagerRefs e0
eagerRefs (EStringInterp parts) = flatMap eagerRefsInterp parts
eagerRefs (EGuards arms) = flatMap eagerRefsGuardArm arms
eagerRefs (ESection (SecRight _ e0)) = eagerRefs e0
eagerRefs (ESection (SecLeft e0 _)) = eagerRefs e0
eagerRefs (EAsPat _ e0) = eagerRefs e0
eagerRefs (EMapLit _ kvs) = flatMap eagerRefsPair kvs
eagerRefs (ESetLit _ es) = flatMap eagerRefs es
eagerRefs (ELoc _ e) = eagerRefs e
eagerRefs (EDoOrigin _ e) = eagerRefs e
eagerRefs _ = []

eagerRefsLetBind : LetBind -> List String
eagerRefsLetBind (LetBind _ clauses _ _) =
  flatMap eagerRefsClauseAllPats clauses

-- Unlike the group-membership test above (which only examines zero-param
-- clauses), a NESTED ELetGroup's own function-form members are legitimately
-- deferred (their body only runs once applied) — so only fold in a nested
-- zero-param clause's refs eagerly; a nested function clause's body is safe
-- to skip, matching the ELam short-circuit above.
eagerRefsClauseAllPats : FunClause -> List String
eagerRefsClauseAllPats (FunClause [] rhs) = eagerRefs rhs
eagerRefsClauseAllPats (FunClause _ _) = []

eagerRefsArm : Arm -> List String
eagerRefsArm (Arm _ gs body) = flatMap eagerRefsGuard gs ++ eagerRefs body

eagerRefsGuard : Guard -> List String
eagerRefsGuard (GBool e) = eagerRefs e
eagerRefsGuard (GBind _ e) = eagerRefs e

eagerRefsGuardArm : GuardArm -> List String
eagerRefsGuardArm (GuardArm gs body) =
  flatMap eagerRefsGuard gs ++ eagerRefs body

eagerRefsFieldAssign : FieldAssign -> List String
eagerRefsFieldAssign (FieldAssign _ e) = eagerRefs e

eagerRefsDoStmt : DoStmt -> List String
eagerRefsDoStmt (DoExpr e) = eagerRefs e
eagerRefsDoStmt (DoBind _ e) = eagerRefs e
eagerRefsDoStmt (DoLet _ _ _ e _) = eagerRefs e
eagerRefsDoStmt _ = []

eagerRefsInterp : InterpPart -> List String
eagerRefsInterp (InterpExpr e) = eagerRefs e
eagerRefsInterp _ = []

eagerRefsPair : (Expr, Expr) -> List String
eagerRefsPair (k, v) = eagerRefs k ++ eagerRefs v

groupNames : List (String, (List Pat, Expr)) -> OrdMap Unit -> List String
groupNames [] _ = []
groupNames ((n, _) :: rest) seen = match omLookup n seen
  Some _ => groupNames rest seen
  None => n :: groupNames rest (omInsert n () seen)

-- process one dependency component of a where block: bind names, infer,
-- generalize
processLetGroup : TcEnv -> List LetBind -> TcEnv
processLetGroup env binds =
  let _ = enterLevel env.teDyn.dcModule ()
  let _ = beginEffectSummaryScope env.teDyn.dcModule ()
  let oblN0 = wMark env.teDyn.dcModule.mcCells.implObls
  let callN0 = wMark env.teDyn.dcModule.mcCells.obls
  let dictN0 = goalsMark env.teDyn.dcModule.mcGraph ()
  let summaries = map (localBindingSummary env.teDyn.dcModule) binds
  let _ =
    fold
      (_ entry => recordLetBindType env.teDyn.dcModule.mcGraph entry)
      ()
      (zipL binds summaries)
  let placeholders = map (p => (fst p, monoScheme (snd p).bsValue)) summaries
  let recursive =
    map (p => (fst p, monoScheme (snd p).bsRecursiveValue)) summaries
  let env2 = extendLocalVars env recursive
  let _ =
    fold
      (_ bind => forgetLocalAbs env.teDyn.dcModule.mcGraph (letBindName bind))
      ()
      binds
  let lscopes = inferLetBinds env2 (zipL binds summaries)
  let _ =
    fold (_ entry => checkRecursiveValue env.teDyn (snd entry)) () summaries
  let residuals =
    finishValueEffectsKeeping
      env.teDyn
      (map (letBindGeneralizes env) (zipL binds summaries))
  let _ = flushPendingEscapes env.teDyn.dcModule env.teDyn.dcGroup
  let _ = exitLevel env.teDyn.dcModule ()
  -- PLAN.md #11 / D4, as a where block narrows it (#3487): ground the Num-only
  -- vars owned by this just-exited component that no member's type mentions
  -- (nothing can generalize them).  One a member's type does mention, even in
  -- return position, generalizes with its constraint, so a sibling or the
  -- enclosing body instantiates it (`two _ = 2` beside `go y = y / two ()`);
  -- the enclosing binding's boundary decides what its uses leave ambiguous.
  -- Scoped to this group's newly added obligations.
  let addedObls = wWindow env.teDyn.dcModule.mcCells.implObls oblN0
  let _ = improveLocalGoals env.teDyn addedObls callN0
  let memberMonos = map (p => schemeMono (snd p)) placeholders
  let _ = finalizeNumBoundary env.teDyn NumBoundary {
    nbDisposition =
      NumBoundaryOwnedGroup (env.teDyn.dcModule.mcCells.currentLevel.value + 1),
    nbMembers = memberMonos,
    nbSurvivingIds = omEmpty,
    nbDefaultObls = addedObls,
    nbAmbiguityObls = addedObls,
    nbGuard = localNumGuard env.teDyn.dcModule addedObls callN0,
  }  -- RETPOS soundness
  let genv = generalizeGroup env residuals 0 (zipL binds placeholders)
  -- Round-2 adversarial break "let-alias evasion" (#816): a LOCAL constrained
  -- binding (`let f = hh` re-generalizing `hh : Num x => x -> x`) previously
  -- registered NOTHING in schemeObligationsRef — only top-level SCCs did — so a
  -- later use `f x` instantiated no obligation at all: the one recorded at the
  -- RHS occurrence stayed on a var the generalization then orphaned, Int
  -- defaulting quietly satisfied it, and a scheme-var instantiation sailed
  -- through check into an eval panic / native SEGFAULT.  Register the group
  -- exactly as processSCC does; instantiateVarTracked's per-use re-recording
  -- then feeds the same call-obligation window every checker reads.  Name
  -- collisions across bodies are safe: the obligation ids are the scheme's own
  -- quantified ids, and substMonos skips entries whose ids a different scheme's
  -- instantiation does not map.
  let callOblsDelta = callOblsWindow env.teDyn.dcModule callN0
  let schemes = groupSchemesOf genv binds
  let _ = fold (_ p => declareQuantified env.teDyn.dcModule (snd p)) () schemes
  -- #827/#838 I2: register EVERYWHERE, not only inside a method body.  The
  -- uniform deferral (`undeterminedGoalExempt`'s OD2 test) makes a generalizable
  -- where/let var defer into the enclosing scheme rather than trip an ambiguity
  -- reject, closing the orphaned-local-constraint S0 (#827).  See registerLocalScheme.
  -- #838 I5: dict-slot forwarding rides callOblsDelta's PCallSlot obligations (see
  -- registerLocalScheme); the redundant `allDictObls` re-derivation is retired.
  let _ =
    registerSchemeObligations
      env.teDyn.dcModule
      omEmpty
      []
      callOblsDelta
      addedObls
      schemes
  let _ = registerLocalGroupAbs genv oblN0 callN0 (zipL binds lscopes)
  genv

-- A where/let group member's own type cell, the one its clauses are inferred
-- into, published with the member's declared parameter count.  A member is never
-- signed: a `LetBind` carries no type signature.
recordLetBindType : GraphCtx -> (LetBind, (String, BindingSummary)) -> Unit
recordLetBindType gctx (LetBind name _ _ bid, (_, summary)) =
  recordBinderType gctx bid name summary.bsValue (Some summary.bsArity) False

-- Whether a where/let group member generalizes, and its type.
letBindGeneralizes : TcEnv ->
  (LetBind, (String, BindingSummary)) ->
  (Bool, Mono)
letBindGeneralizes env (LetBind _ clauses _ _, (_, summary)) =
  (clausesAreValue env clauses, summary.bsValue)

registerLocalGroupAbs : TcEnv ->
  Int ->
  Int ->
  List (LetBind, Option ScopeId) ->
  Unit
registerLocalGroupAbs env _ _ [] = ()
registerLocalGroupAbs genv oblN0 callN0 ((bind@(LetBind name _ _ _), lscope) :: rest) =
  let _ = match lookupVar genv name
    Some sch =>
      registerLocalAbsIf genv.teDyn.dcModule name lscope sch oblN0 callN0
    None => ()
  registerLocalGroupAbs genv oblN0 callN0 rest

-- the generalized (name, scheme) pairs of a just-closed local group
groupSchemesOf : TcEnv -> List LetBind -> List (String, Scheme)
groupSchemesOf env [] = []
groupSchemesOf genv ((LetBind name _ _ _) :: rest) = match lookupVar genv name
  Some sch => (name, sch) :: groupSchemesOf genv rest
  None => groupSchemesOf genv rest

localBindingSummary : ModuleCtx -> LetBind -> (String, BindingSummary)
localBindingSummary mctx (LetBind name clauses _ _) =
  let arity = match map funClausePair clauses
    (pats, _) :: _ => listLen pats
    [] => 0
  (name, newBindingSummary arity (freshVar mctx) (freshEffectSummary mctx))

inferLetBinds : TcEnv ->
  List (LetBind, (String, BindingSummary)) ->
  List (Option ScopeId)
inferLetBinds env [] = []
inferLetBinds env ((bind@(LetBind name clauses _ _), (_, owned)) :: rest) =
  let pairs = map funClausePair clauses
  let lscope =
    if isLocalAbsName name then
      Some (openLocalScope env.teDyn.dcModule name)
    else
      None
  let _ = inferMemberClauses env None owned pairs
  let _ = closeLocalScope env.teDyn.dcModule lscope
  let _ = match pairs
    [([], _)] =>
      performEffect
        env.teDyn.dcModule
        env.teDyn.dcModule.mcCells.curEffect
        owned.bsForce
    _ => ()
  lscope :: inferLetBinds env rest

anyIn : List Int -> List Int -> Bool
anyIn xs ys = anyList (x => containsI x ys) xs

-- the unbound var ids that any pending `Num` obligation in [obls] constrains (the
-- operand monos recorded by recordIfaceObligation / the literal infer arm)
numConstrainedIds : List UObligation -> List Int
numConstrainedIds obls = flatMap numObligIds obls

numObligIds : UObligation -> List Int
numObligIds o = match o.oblProj
  OpMethodOcc _ _ occ _ =>
    if o.pred.iface.irName == "Num" then monoUnboundIds occ else []
  OpExactReturn request =>
    if o.pred.iface.irName == "Num" then
      monoUnboundIds request.mrrOccurrence
    else
      []
  OpProjected => []
  OpNumLit occ => monoUnboundIds occ

armNumGuard : GraphCtx -> NumGuard -> ArmedGuard
armNumGuard gctx guard = ArmedGuard {
  agWindow =
    goalWindowOf gctx (filterList (guardsDefaulting gctx) guard.ngGoals),
  agRigidIds = guard.ngRigidIds,
  agOuterBelow = guard.ngOuterBelow,
  agWithheld = Ref [],
}

-- In D3 clause 3's scope: arity two or more, and two or more distinct variables.
guardsDefaulting : GraphCtx -> UObligation -> Bool
guardsDefaulting gctx o =
  hasVectorArgs gctx o
    && listLen (dedupI (flatMap monoUnboundIds (uOblArgs gctx o))) > 1

-- Grounding [id] to Int leaves satisfiable every in-scope goal on it that is
-- satisfiable now.
defaultKeepsGoalsSatisfiable : ModuleCtx -> ArmedGuard -> Int -> Bool
defaultKeepsGoalsSatisfiable mctx guard id =
  allList
    (i => match IdMap.get i guard.agWindow.gwByIndex
      Some o => goalSatisfiableAfterDefault mctx guard id o
      None => True)
    (goalsOnVar guard.agWindow id)

-- A goal unsatisfiable with [id] open is unsatisfiable at every type, so
-- withholding [id] could not help it.
goalSatisfiableAfterDefault : ModuleCtx ->
  ArmedGuard ->
  Int ->
  UObligation ->
  Bool
goalSatisfiableAfterDefault mctx guard id o =
  let args = map normalize (uOblArgs mctx.mcGraph o)
  if not (containsI id (flatMap monoUnboundIds args)) then
    True
  else
    let after = map (cohApply (Ref [(id, tconBuiltin "Int")])) args
    let rigidIds = outerRigidIds guard.agOuterBelow args guard.agRigidIds
    goalSatisfiable mctx rigidIds o after
      || not (goalSatisfiable mctx rigidIds o args)

-- Some instance head unifies with [args], [rigidIds] held rigid and the
-- instance's variables fresh, or a given covers them.
goalSatisfiable : ModuleCtx -> OrdMap Unit -> UObligation -> List Mono -> Bool
goalSatisfiable mctx rigidIds o args =
  isNonEmptyL
      (goalCandidates mctx rigidIds args (goalRows mctx o.pred.iface args))
    || goalGivenAt mctx.mcGraph o.pred.iface args o.uoScope

-- [base] plus each variable of [args] whose level is below [level].
outerRigidIds : Option Int -> List Mono -> OrdMap Unit -> OrdMap Unit
outerRigidIds outerBelow args base =
  omFromNames (map intToString (enclosingVarIds outerBelow args)) base

-- The variables of [args] an enclosing binder owns: those below [outerBelow].
-- A boundary with no enclosing binder (`None`) has none.
enclosingVarIds : Option Int -> List Mono -> List Int
enclosingVarIds None _ = []
enclosingVarIds (Some level) args =
  map fst (filterList (p => snd p < level) (flatMap monoUnboundVarLevels args))

-- D1: one operation performs defaulting first, then ambiguity registration.  It
-- returns the candidates D3 clause 3 withheld, for the boundary's verdict.
finalizeNumBoundary : DynCtx -> NumBoundary -> List Mono
finalizeNumBoundary dyn boundary =
  let guard = armNumGuard dyn.dcModule.mcGraph boundary.nbGuard
  let defaultOwnerPolicy = match boundary.nbDisposition
    NumBoundaryOwnedMember owner => Some owner
    NumBoundaryOwnedGroup owner => Some owner
    NumBoundaryOwnedScc _ => None
    NumBoundaryOwnedMethodBody owner => Some owner
  let ambiguityOwner = match boundary.nbDisposition
    NumBoundaryOwnedMember owner => Some owner
    NumBoundaryOwnedGroup owner => Some owner
    NumBoundaryOwnedScc owner => Some owner
    NumBoundaryOwnedMethodBody owner => Some owner
  let _ = match boundary.nbDisposition
    NumBoundaryOwnedMember owner => match boundary.nbMembers
      [member] =>
        let _ =
          defaultAmbiguousNumWith
            dyn
            defaultOwnerPolicy
            guard
            boundary.nbSurvivingIds
            boundary.nbDefaultObls
            member
        handOffAbsentNumVars dyn.dcModule owner member boundary.nbDefaultObls
      _ => panic "NumBoundaryOwnedMember must carry exactly one member"
    NumBoundaryOwnedGroup _ =>
      defaultAbsentNumWith
        dyn
        defaultOwnerPolicy
        guard
        boundary.nbSurvivingIds
        boundary.nbDefaultObls
        boundary.nbMembers
    NumBoundaryOwnedScc _ =>
      let _ =
        defaultGroupNumWith
          dyn
          defaultOwnerPolicy
          guard
          boundary.nbSurvivingIds
          boundary.nbDefaultObls
          boundary.nbMembers
      defaultEachMemberWith
        dyn
        defaultOwnerPolicy
        guard
        boundary.nbSurvivingIds
        boundary.nbDefaultObls
        boundary.nbMembers
    NumBoundaryOwnedMethodBody _ => match boundary.nbMembers
      [_] =>
        defaultBodyLocalNumWith
          dyn
          defaultOwnerPolicy
          guard
          boundary.nbSurvivingIds
          boundary.nbDefaultObls
      _ => panic "NumBoundaryOwnedMethodBody must carry exactly one member"
  let _ = match ambiguityOwner
    Some owner =>
      registerAmbiguousConstraintsOwnedBy
        dyn.dcModule
        owner
        boundary.nbGuard.ngOuterBelow
        boundary.nbAmbiguityObls
        boundary.nbMembers
    None => ()
  !guard.agWithheld

-- A local binding's Num roots that its type does not mention (a key literal it
-- consumes) are no scheme's and no caller's, but its goals may still connect them
-- to variables the enclosing boundary settles, and that boundary determines before
-- it defaults.  They are lowered to the enclosing level, as `lowerToCurrent` lowers
-- a value-restricted type, so that boundary owns them.  A deeper root is an inner
-- binding's and stays where it is.
handOffAbsentNumVars : ModuleCtx -> Int -> Mono -> List UObligation -> Unit
handOffAbsentNumVars mctx owner member obls =
  let inT = monoUnboundIds member
  fold
    (_ id =>
      if containsI id inT then
        ()
      else match liveNumVarGo id obls
        Some m => lowerOwnedRoot mctx owner m
        None => ())
    ()
    (dedupI (numConstrainedIds obls))

defaultAmbiguousNumWith : DynCtx ->
  Option Int ->
  ArmedGuard ->
  OrdMap Unit ->
  List UObligation ->
  Mono ->
  Unit
defaultAmbiguousNumWith dyn ownerPolicy guard protectedIds obls t =
  let argIds = monoArgUnboundIds t
  let inT = monoUnboundIds t
  let candidates = unprotectedNumCandidates protectedIds obls
  groundNumVarsWith
    dyn
    ownerPolicy
    guard
    obls
    (filterList
      (id => containsI id inT && not (containsI id argIds))
      candidates)

-- group-level defaulting: ground every unprotected Num-constrained var NOT reachable
-- from an ARGUMENT position of ANY member's type.  [monos] = the group's member
-- placeholder monos; [obls] = ONLY this group's newly-added obligations (an earlier
-- group's already-generalized var must not be touched).  Unlike the member policy,
-- this does NOT require the var to appear in a member's type (a var consumed inside a
-- body surfaces in no type but must still ground — `let n = tag [1,2,3]`).  Mirrors
-- process_letrec_group's group_arg_ids over added_obligs/added_methods.
defaultGroupNumWith : DynCtx ->
  Option Int ->
  ArmedGuard ->
  OrdMap Unit ->
  List UObligation ->
  List Mono ->
  Unit
defaultGroupNumWith dyn ownerPolicy guard protectedIds obls monos =
  let argIds = flatMap monoArgUnboundIds monos
  let candidates = unprotectedNumCandidates protectedIds obls
  groundNumVarsWith
    dyn
    ownerPolicy
    guard
    obls
    (filterList (id => not (containsI id argIds)) candidates)

-- where-component defaulting: ground every unprotected Num-constrained var no
-- member's type mentions (a var consumed inside a body, `n = length [1, 2]`).
-- A var a member's type mentions generalizes with its constraint instead.
defaultAbsentNumWith : DynCtx ->
  Option Int ->
  ArmedGuard ->
  OrdMap Unit ->
  List UObligation ->
  List Mono ->
  Unit
defaultAbsentNumWith dyn ownerPolicy guard protectedIds obls monos =
  let inTypes = flatMap monoUnboundIds monos
  let candidates = unprotectedNumCandidates protectedIds obls
  groundNumVarsWith
    dyn
    ownerPolicy
    guard
    obls
    (filterList (id => not (containsI id inTypes)) candidates)

unprotectedNumCandidates : OrdMap Unit -> List UObligation -> List Int
unprotectedNumCandidates protectedIds obls =
  filterList
    (id => not (omHasKey (intToString id) protectedIds))
    (dedupI (numConstrainedIds obls))

-- The D3 channel rule is an identity intersection, not whole-type reachability:
-- only roots constrained by this boundary's own Num obligations can survive, and
-- only when the supplied head/dictionary channels carry that exact live root.
numChannelRootSet : List UObligation -> List Mono -> OrdMap Unit
numChannelRootSet obls channels =
  let channelIds = monoRootIdSet channels
  omFromNames
    (filterList
      (name => omHasKey name channelIds)
      (map intToString (dedupI (numConstrainedIds obls))))
    omEmpty

-- D3 clause 2, the argument channel closed under connection: [base] plus the
-- variables of [members]' types, outside an argument position, that a
-- multi-variable goal of [guard] connects, transitively, to an argument-position
-- variable or to an enclosing binder's variable (one below the guard's
-- [ngOuterBelow]).  A caller fixes them through those goals, or the enclosing
-- binder's boundary does, so they are not defaulting candidates here.  Only
-- defaulting reads this set: improvement and determination keep the
-- declared-signature and unowned sets, since holding a connected variable rigid
-- there would stop the unique instance from fixing it.
tiedSurvivors : GraphCtx -> List Mono -> NumGuard -> OrdMap Unit -> OrdMap Unit
tiedSurvivors gctx members guard base =
  let enclosing =
    enclosingVarIds guard.ngOuterBelow (flatMap (uOblArgs gctx) guard.ngGoals)
  omFromNames
    (map intToString (connectedTiedIds gctx enclosing members guard.ngGoals))
    base

-- A local binding's surviving set: its one member's, over its goals on both
-- windows.
memberTiedSurvivors : ModuleCtx ->
  Mono ->
  List UObligation ->
  Int ->
  OrdMap Unit
memberTiedSurvivors mctx member addedObls callN0 =
  tiedSurvivors
    mctx.mcGraph
    [member]
    (localNumGuard mctx addedObls callN0)
    omEmpty

-- A local binding's or `where` component's D3 clause 3 inputs: its goals on both
-- windows, with the variables of an enclosing binder held rigid.  Called right
-- after the boundary's level is exited.
localNumGuard : ModuleCtx -> List UObligation -> Int -> NumGuard
localNumGuard mctx addedObls callN0 = NumGuard {
  ngGoals = addedObls ++ callUOblsWindow mctx callN0,
  ngRigidIds = omEmpty,
  ngOuterBelow = Some (mctx.mcCells.currentLevel.value + 1),
}

-- A local boundary's goals are improved before it generalizes, as a top-level
-- group's are (DICT-SEMANTICS §3 "When"), so its scheme is built from the improved
-- type.  A variable below the just-exited level is an enclosing binder's to settle,
-- so it takes part as a constant.
improveLocalGoals : DynCtx -> List UObligation -> Int -> Unit
improveLocalGoals dyn addedObls callN0 =
  let goals = addedObls ++ callUOblsWindow dyn.dcModule callN0
  let outer =
    outerRigidIds
      (Some (dyn.dcModule.mcCells.currentLevel.value + 1))
      (flatMap (uOblArgs dyn.dcModule.mcGraph) goals)
      omEmpty
  improveByUniqueImpl dyn outer goals

connectedTiedIds : GraphCtx ->
  List Int ->
  List Mono ->
  List UObligation ->
  List Int
connectedTiedIds gctx enclosing members obls =
  match enclosing ++ flatMap monoArgUnboundIds members
    [] => []
    seedList =>
      let seeds = idSetOf seedList Tip
      let reached = connectedIds gctx seeds obls
      filterList
        (id => IdMap.has id reached && not (IdMap.has id seeds))
        (dedupI (flatMap monoUnboundIds members))

-- [seeds] grown by the variables of every goal of [obls] that meets them.
connectedIds : GraphCtx -> Map Int Unit -> List UObligation -> Map Int Unit
connectedIds gctx seeds obls =
  connectClosure
    seeds
    (filterList
      (ids => listLen ids > 1)
      (map (o => dedupI (flatMap monoUnboundIds (uOblArgs gctx o))) obls))

-- Each pass absorbs every vector that meets [reached] and keeps the rest for the
-- next pass, so a vector is absorbed at most once.
connectClosure : Map Int Unit -> List (List Int) -> Map Int Unit
connectClosure reached vectors = match absorbMeeting reached vectors [] False
  (grown, rest, True) => connectClosure grown rest
  (grown, _, False) => grown

absorbMeeting : Map Int Unit ->
  List (List Int) ->
  List (List Int) ->
  Bool ->
  (Map Int Unit, List (List Int), Bool)
absorbMeeting reached [] rest grew = (reached, rest, grew)
absorbMeeting reached (v :: vs) rest grew =
  if anyList (i => IdMap.has i reached) v then
    absorbMeeting (idSetOf v reached) vs rest True
  else
    absorbMeeting reached vs (v :: rest) grew

-- Not `IdMap.fromList`: it allocates a pair per id and needs a union with [acc].
idSetOf : List Int -> Map Int Unit -> Map Int Unit
idSetOf [] acc = acc
idSetOf (i :: more) acc = idSetOf more (IdMap.set i () acc)

-- #518/#563: BODY-LOCAL defaulting — ground only Num-constrained roots absent from
-- [protectedIds], the boundary's explicit set of still-live determination channels.
-- Strictly narrower than group defaulting, and the distinction is
-- SOUNDNESS-CRITICAL at an impl-method body, which is why this is a separate
-- primitive rather than a reuse.
--
-- Group defaulting's exclusion filter is monoArgUnboundIds, which walks ONLY the
-- domains of the outermost arrow chain.  A var living in RETURN position — including
-- nested inside a return application — is invisible to it and gets ZERO protection.
-- At a let-group that is (mostly) benign: the binding generalizes, so a return-only
-- var is usually ambiguous anyway.  At an IMPL METHOD BODY it is NOT, and the reason
-- is dict-passing: an impl method's OWN method-level constraint var
-- (`lift : Num b => a -> Box b`) is supplied by a DICT at the CALL SITE, so the
-- caller genuinely chooses it (`q : Box Float; q = lift 3` ⇒ b↦Float).  Grounding it
-- to Int here would permanently monomorphise a var the caller had already fixed —
-- MEASURED: `MkBox 0.0` before, `E-PANIC: floatToString: not a Float` after, i.e.
-- trading #518's S0 for a new one.  Return-position type params are exactly what
-- typeclass dispatch concentrates, so this site's density of the triggering shape is
-- far higher than a let-group's.
--
-- The impl boundary supplies only roots shared with its instance head or declared
-- method dictionaries. The generic-default boundary still supplies every root in
-- its declared method mono, preserving its existing policy until it gains the same
-- concrete construction context. #518's shape is the complement: the element var
-- of `s [1, 2]` in
-- `t _ = s [1, 2]` is consumed entirely inside the body and surfaces nowhere in
-- `t : Option2 Int -> Int`, so nothing outside the body can ever determine it.  That
-- var, and only that var, is what this grounds.
defaultBodyLocalNumWith : DynCtx ->
  Option Int ->
  ArmedGuard ->
  OrdMap Unit ->
  List UObligation ->
  Unit
defaultBodyLocalNumWith dyn ownerPolicy guard protectedIds obls =
  let candidates = unprotectedNumCandidates protectedIds obls
  groundNumVarsWith dyn ownerPolicy guard obls candidates

-- per-binding defaulting: run the member rule on each placeholder mono
defaultEachMemberWith : DynCtx ->
  Option Int ->
  ArmedGuard ->
  OrdMap Unit ->
  List UObligation ->
  List Mono ->
  Unit
defaultEachMemberWith dyn _ _ _ _ [] = ()
defaultEachMemberWith dyn ownerPolicy guard protectedIds obls (m :: rest) =
  let _ = defaultAmbiguousNumWith dyn ownerPolicy guard protectedIds obls m
  defaultEachMemberWith dyn ownerPolicy guard protectedIds obls rest

-- RETPOS soundness — ambiguous interface constraint (run≠build hole).
-- A method obligation recorded inside a binding whose discriminating tyvar is
-- UNBOUND, UNANCHORED, and appears NOWHERE in the binding's generalized type is
-- genuinely ambiguous (`make`'s result var in `f x = reveal (make (reveal x))`,
-- `f : Thing a => a -> Int`: `make`'s var is tied to neither `a` nor the result).
-- No annotation determines the instance and, with ≥2 impls, eval vs emit default
-- to DIFFERENT impls — a silent run≠build miscompile (RETPOS-DISPATCH-DESIGN.md).
-- We REJECT it by handing the genuine ambiguous DISPATCH mono to the existing
-- undetermined-obligation path (registering it as a call obligation), which
-- rejects (ambiguousImplMsg) under the SAME exemptions (`undeterminedGoalExempt`)
-- and the SAME candidate count (`goalCandidates`) an undetermined call site already
-- gets (so a goal one instance determines is never over-rejected and `Num` stays on
-- its literal-defaulting path).  Four filters
-- keep this from firing on legitimately-deferred constraints:
--   • member-type membership (`monoUnboundIds`) — a var IN the
--     binding's type is determined by a caller/annotation;
--   • group LEVEL — a DEEPER var belongs to an inner let/where binding that already
--     generalized + checked it (its obligation merely leaks into our addedObls
--     window, e.g. `maximum`'s `where step` comparing at step's own element var);
--   • enclosing vars — at a local boundary, a var below its `ngOuterBelow` belongs to
--     an enclosing binder (`v`'s type in `g v = let s = v[0]`), judged where it lives;
--   • ANCHORED vars — a var that also appears inside a CONCRETE-HEADED dispatch mono
--     of this binding (`Set _a` from a `Set {…}` literal's FromEntries/Display) is
--     ground at emit by head-pinning, so it is sound-but-deferred, NOT ambiguous.
-- The obligation's record-site loc rides along (post-HM there is no construct).
registerAmbiguousConstraintsOwnedBy : ModuleCtx ->
  Int ->
  Option Int ->
  List UObligation ->
  List Mono ->
  Unit
registerAmbiguousConstraintsOwnedBy mctx owner outerBelow obls monos =
  -- anchoredIds = every unbound var that appears inside a concrete-headed dispatch
  -- mono across this group's obligations (head-pinnable).
  let dispatchMonos = flatMap oblDispatchMonos obls
  let anchoredIds = flatMap concreteHeadVarIds dispatchMonos
  -- An enclosing binder's variable is that binder's question: its boundary sees
  -- the same goal with the variable in its own type.
  let enclosingIds = enclosingVarIds outerBelow dispatchMonos
  registerAmbiguousGo
    mctx
    obls
    owner
    (flatMap monoUnboundIds monos ++ enclosingIds)
    anchoredIds

-- the dispatch monos this obligation discriminates on (empty for Num, whose
-- ambiguity is handled by literal defaulting).
oblDispatchMonos : UObligation -> List Mono
oblDispatchMonos o = match o.oblProj
  OpProjected => []
  OpMethodOcc typarams mty occ _ =>
    oblDispatchMonosGo o.pred.iface.irName typarams mty occ
  OpExactReturn request =>
    oblDispatchMonosGo
      request.mrrIface.irName
      request.mrrTyparams
      request.mrrType
      request.mrrOccurrence
  OpNumLit _ => []

oblDispatchMonosGo : String -> List String -> Ty -> Mono -> List Mono
oblDispatchMonosGo iface typarams mty occ
  | iface == "Num" = []
  -- F0: dispatch/ambiguity keys off the RECEIVER (dispatch) typaram only, NOT every
  -- interface typaram.  A return-only typaram (`v` in `Get c v where get1 : c -> v`)
  -- is determined by the impl AFTER the receiver picks it, so it must never be
  -- registered as an independent impl-selection obligation — else the still-unbound
  -- `v`, which the selected instance determines later, is re-checked as a single-mono
  -- obligation with no matching impl (`No impl of Get for Int`).  dispatchTyparams
  -- = [first typaram], the same receiver classification argDispatchOfMethod uses.
  | otherwise = dispatchMonosOf (dispatchTyparams typarams) mty occ

registerAmbiguousGo : ModuleCtx ->
  List UObligation ->
  Int ->
  List Int ->
  List Int ->
  Unit
registerAmbiguousGo mctx [] _ _ _ = ()
registerAmbiguousGo mctx (o :: rest) groupLevel memberIds anchoredIds =
  let _ = match o.oblProj
    OpMethodOcc typarams mty occ _ =>
      registerOneAmbiguous
        mctx
        o.pred.iface
        typarams
        mty
        occ
        o.loc
        o.uoScope
        groupLevel
        memberIds
        anchoredIds
    OpExactReturn request =>
      registerOneAmbiguous
        mctx
        request.mrrIface
        request.mrrTyparams
        request.mrrType
        request.mrrOccurrence
        request.mrrLoc
        request.mrrScope
        groupLevel
        memberIds
        anchoredIds
    OpProjected => ()
    OpNumLit _ => ()
  registerAmbiguousGo mctx rest groupLevel memberIds anchoredIds

-- For each of this obligation's DISPATCH monos (the interface-param positions, via
-- dispatchMonosOf — NOT the whole method type), register it as a call obligation
-- when it carries an escaped, unanchored this-group var.  Pushing the dispatch mono
-- (not the method type) is essential: the undetermined-goal verdict's guards
-- (`headTyconMono`, `activeDictVarOf`, `allConcreteHeads`) inspect a bare dispatch
-- mono and do NOT traverse `TFun`, so a concrete-headed dispatch and a forwarded-
-- dict element var are correctly NOT flagged, while a bare-var dispatch with ≥2
-- impls and no anchor (`Thing t0` from `make`) IS rejected.
registerOneAmbiguous : ModuleCtx ->
  IfaceRef ->
  List String ->
  Ty ->
  Mono ->
  Option Loc ->
  ScopeId ->
  Int ->
  List Int ->
  List Int ->
  Unit
registerOneAmbiguous mctx iface typarams mty occ loc scope groupLevel memberIds anchoredIds
  | iface.irName == "Num" = ()
  -- F0: register call obligations for the RECEIVER (dispatch) typaram only — a
  -- return-only typaram is impl-determined, not an impl-selection key (see
  -- oblDispatchMonos).
  | otherwise =
    registerDispatchMonos
      mctx
      iface
      (dispatchMonosOf (dispatchTyparams typarams) mty occ)
      loc
      scope
      groupLevel
      memberIds
      anchoredIds

registerDispatchMonos : ModuleCtx ->
  IfaceRef ->
  List Mono ->
  Option Loc ->
  ScopeId ->
  Int ->
  List Int ->
  List Int ->
  Unit
registerDispatchMonos mctx _ [] _ _ _ _ _ = ()
registerDispatchMonos mctx iface (dm :: rest) loc scope groupLevel memberIds anchoredIds =
  let ambig =
    filterList
      (p =>
        snd p <= groupLevel
          && not (containsI (fst p) memberIds)
          && not (containsI (fst p) anchoredIds))
      (monoUnboundVarLevels dm)
  let _ =
    if isEmptyL ambig then
      ()
    else
      recordOblAt
        mctx
        Predicate { iface = iface, args = [dm] }
        0
        PCallSlot
        loc
        scope
  registerDispatchMonos
    mctx
    iface
    rest
    loc
    scope
    groupLevel
    memberIds
    anchoredIds

-- Ownership is exact at lexical boundaries: an outer or deeper root survives.
-- None preserves the legacy SCC/body-local policy until graph-end defaulting (#2646)
-- can safely own the roots that exact SCC filtering would strand.
numDefaultOwnerAllows : Option Int -> Mono -> Bool
numDefaultOwnerAllows None _ = True
numDefaultOwnerAllows (Some level) m = match normalize m
  TVar r => match r.value
    Unbound _ owner => owner == level
    _ => False
  _ => False

-- Outer variable is not owned by boundary 7.
-- > numDefaultOwnerAllows (Some 7) (TVar (Ref (Unbound 91001 6)))
-- False
--
-- Exact owner is eligible.
-- > numDefaultOwnerAllows (Some 7) (TVar (Ref (Unbound 91002 7)))
-- True
--
-- Deeper variable is not owned by boundary 7.
-- > numDefaultOwnerAllows (Some 7) (TVar (Ref (Unbound 91003 8)))
-- False
--
-- Ownership follows the normalized root.
-- > numDefaultOwnerAllows (Some 7) (TVar (Ref (Link (TVar (Ref (Unbound 91004 7))))))
-- True
--
-- An owned method body defaults only a root minted in its own inference window.
-- > numDefaultOwnerAllows (Some 6) (TVar (Ref (Unbound 91005 6)))
-- True

-- Ground each id to Int by unifying the live var carrying it (found among [obls]'
-- Num operand monos — refs alias post-unify, grounding any grounds all), unless
-- D3 clause 3 withholds it.
groundNumVarsWith : DynCtx ->
  Option Int ->
  ArmedGuard ->
  List UObligation ->
  List Int ->
  Unit
groundNumVarsWith dyn _ _ _ [] = ()
groundNumVarsWith dyn ownerPolicy guard obls (id :: rest)
  | omHasKey
    (intToString id)
    dyn.dcModule.mcGraph.graphRun.localAbs.lasQuantified.value =
    groundNumVarsWith dyn ownerPolicy guard obls rest
groundNumVarsWith dyn ownerPolicy guard obls (id :: rest) =
  let _ = match liveNumVarGo id obls
    Some m =>
      if numDefaultOwnerAllows ownerPolicy m then
        groundOrWithhold dyn guard id m
    None => ()
  groundNumVarsWith dyn ownerPolicy guard obls rest

groundOrWithhold : DynCtx -> ArmedGuard -> Int -> Mono -> Unit
groundOrWithhold dyn guard id m =
  if defaultKeepsGoalsSatisfiable dyn.dcModule guard id then
    unifyIn dyn m (tconBuiltin "Int")
  else
    guard.agWithheld := m :: !guard.agWithheld

liveNumVarGo : Int -> List UObligation -> Option Mono
liveNumVarGo _ [] = None
liveNumVarGo id (o :: rest) = match o.oblProj
  OpMethodOcc _ _ occ _ =>
    if o.pred.iface.irName == "Num" then match findTvarInMono occ id
      Some m => Some m
      None => liveNumVarGo id rest
    else
      liveNumVarGo id rest
  OpExactReturn request =>
    if o.pred.iface.irName
      == "Num" then match findTvarInMono request.mrrOccurrence id
      Some m => Some m
      None => liveNumVarGo id rest
    else
      liveNumVarGo id rest
  OpProjected => liveNumVarGo id rest
  OpNumLit occ => match findTvarInMono occ id
    Some m => Some m
    None => liveNumVarGo id rest

generalizeGroup : TcEnv ->
  List (Int, AuthResidual) ->
  Int ->
  List (LetBind, (String, Scheme)) ->
  TcEnv
generalizeGroup env _ _ [] = env
generalizeGroup env residuals index ((LetBind name clauses _ _, (_, sch)) :: rest) =
  let mono = schemeMono sch
  let isVal = clausesAreValue env clauses
  -- WS-2: α scope-seed — single-clause zero-param bindings only (mirror α's
  -- alphaCollectBinds rule); a multi-clause / parameterized binding is not a
  -- known prefix.
  let env1 =
    extendLocalVar
      env
      name
      (genBindingRestricted
        env.teDyn
        Tip
        (residualsOf index residuals)
        isVal
        pureRow
        mono)
  let env2 = match clauses
    [FunClause [] rhs] => seedAlphaLets env1 name rhs
    _ => env1
  generalizeGroup env2 residuals (index + 1) rest

-- A where-clause binding is a value (generalizable) iff every clause has params
-- (it's a function) or its zero-arg RHS is non-expansive.
clausesAreValue : TcEnv -> List FunClause -> Bool
clausesAreValue env clauses = allList (clauseIsValue env) clauses

clauseIsValue : TcEnv -> FunClause -> Bool
clauseIsValue env (FunClause [] rhs) = isNonexpansive env rhs
clauseIsValue env (FunClause _ _) = True

-- ── elaboration: resolve return-position method dispatch (RKey) ────────────
-- Rewrite each return-position method occurrence to EMethodAt (with a fresh route
-- ref), type-check (recording the sites), then stamp each site's route from its
-- now-resolved result type.  Returns the SAME tree (refs filled) for eval.
-- There is no flat elaboration driver left: every caller goes through the
-- 1-module `elaborateOne` (the typed/dict tree of the degenerate 1-module multi
-- path).

-- ── 1-module wrapper over the multi-module path ────────────────────────────
-- elaborateOne runs the SINGLE program [prog] (the user's decls, the live prelude
-- ALREADY shadow-dropped by the caller) through elaborateModules as the degenerate
-- 1-module list [(rootId, prog)], returning the flat shape its callers consume:
-- core2 (dict-passed core) ++ the dict-passed module's decls.
--
-- The 1-module case automatically satisfies that shape's invariants — one
-- `freshModuleCtx` (one module ⇒ one checkModuleFullImpl), zero imports ⇒ the full
-- constraint set, and elaborateModules runs the eval-dict layer unconditionally
-- (ARGSTAMP-UNIFY Phase 4), so the return-position constrained-fn dict layer is
-- present here too.
--
-- The dict-name set is the module path's own: elaborateModules computes it via
-- `moduleDictNames` (the prelude's constrained names followed by the module graph's
-- FULL `constrainedSigNames`), rather than taking an externally built list.  This
-- wrapper therefore takes `coreDecls` SEPARATE (not pre-flattened into prog),
-- exactly as elaborateModules expects.  The grader for the Flat-vs-Module relation
-- is test/diff_compiler_flat_vs_onemodule.sh (ARCH B-2.1-a): it now pins the
-- own acceptance and diagnostics, and grades the relation only through a clause
-- true on both sides of the #1564 fix — every arm that ACCEPTS must compute the
-- same value.  Read its header before changing either arm.
export
elaborateOne : DriveInputs ->
  List Decl ->
  List Decl ->
  (String, List Decl) ->
  List Decl
elaborateOne inputs runtimeDecls coreDecls prog =
  fst (elaborateOneFacts inputs runtimeDecls coreDecls prog)

-- `elaborateOne` with the `ProgramFacts` value its elaboration built, for a caller that lowers
-- the flat decls.
export
elaborateOneFacts : DriveInputs ->
  List Decl ->
  List Decl ->
  (String, List Decl) ->
  (List Decl, ProgramFacts)
elaborateOneFacts inputs runtimeDecls coreDecls (rootId, prog) =
  let elab = elaborateModules inputs runtimeDecls coreDecls [(rootId, prog)]
  let (coreD, modules, _, _, _, _, _) = elab
  (coreD ++ flatMap snd modules, factsOfElab elab)

-- #415 item 3: the ONLY writer of dictEligibleRef / dictEligibleSetRef.  The set is
-- DERIVED from the list here rather than mirrored at each set site, so the two cannot
-- drift: there is no longer a second side for a future edit to be absent from.  (Both
-- former sites hand-wrote `namesToSet <names> omEmpty` next to the list store; the
-- module site additionally recomputed `moduleUserFnNames modules` for the mirror.)
setDictEligible : GraphCtx -> List String -> Unit
setDictEligible gctx names =
  gctx.dictEligibleRef := names
  gctx.dictEligibleSetRef := namesToSet names omEmpty

-- the USER modules' top-level fn names (NOT core/prelude) — the promotion-eligible
-- set on the build path. Mirrors the retired elaborator's user-function eligibility.
moduleUserFnNames : List (String, List Decl) -> List String
moduleUserFnNames modules =
  dedup (flatMap (p => map fst (funDefs (snd p))) modules)

-- the user program's top-level functions carrying a `=>` constraint in their
-- signature — the set the graph driver dictionary-passes
export
constrainedSigNames : List Decl -> List String
constrainedSigNames prog = flatMap constrainedSigName prog

-- The PRELUDE's own `=>`-constrained fns that must ALSO be dict-passed: those
-- whose body uses a return-position method (`when`/`unless` use `pure`), so
-- arg-tag dispatch can't resolve it at a constraint variable's type.  Every OTHER
-- constrained prelude fn (sum/any/elem/clamp/…) uses only arg-position methods —
-- arg-tag already resolves those, and the goldens type-check with them on RKey, so
-- they stay OUT.  [allDecls] supplies the interface set for returnPosMethodNames;
-- bodies come from [preludeDecls] (the shadow-dropped prelude).
export
preludeReturnPosDictNames : List Decl -> List Decl -> List String
preludeReturnPosDictNames preludeDecls allDecls =
  let rpNames = returnPosMethodNames allDecls
  filterList
    (n => anyMember (declBodyVars n preludeDecls) rpNames)
    (constrainedSigNames preludeDecls)

-- D3b-2: the PRELUDE's `=>`-constrained fns that dispatch a method in ARGUMENT
-- position (the ~23 helpers: neq/elem/any/all/find/count/sum/product/maximum/
-- minimum/clamp/flatMap/flat/debugListItems/displayListItems/hashListItems/print/
-- println).  These stay OUT of the eval/golden dict set — arg-tag resolves them in
-- ceval (tagged values) and the goldens type-check with them on RKey — but the
-- NATIVE emit path MUST dict-pass them: arg-tag cannot dispatch on a PRIMITIVE
-- element (an `Int`/`String` immediate carries no cell tag).  The arg-position
-- analogue of preludeReturnPosDictNames: every constrained prelude fn that is NOT
-- already return-position.  Wired (alongside preludeReturnPosDictNames) into the
-- emit + dict_pp-oracle drivers ONLY (llvm_emit_typed_main / core_ir_dict_pp_main),
-- which no golden driver shares — so module/`=== TYPES ===`/eval goldens stay
-- byte-identical; the body sites route RDict $dict_<method>_<slot> through the same
-- activeDictVars layer registerConstraintRegs already builds for return-position.
export
preludeArgPosDictNames : List Decl -> List Decl -> List String
preludeArgPosDictNames preludeDecls allDecls =
  let rpSet = preludeReturnPosDictNames preludeDecls allDecls
  filterList (n => not (contains n rpSet)) (constrainedSigNames preludeDecls)

-- the EVars referenced anywhere in [n]'s definition body (multi-clause: union)
declBodyVars : String -> List Decl -> List String
declBodyVars n decls = flatMap (declBodyVarsOf n) decls

declBodyVarsOf : String -> Decl -> List String
declBodyVarsOf n (DFunDef _ m _ body _ _)
  | n == m = allEVars body
  | otherwise = []
declBodyVarsOf _ _ = []

-- methods whose interface type param appears ONLY in the result (no argument
-- mentions it) — pure/empty/minBound/maxBound/fromInt/… — are return-position
returnPosMethodNames : List Decl -> List String
returnPosMethodNames prog = flatMap returnPosOfDecl prog

returnPosOfDecl : Decl -> List String
returnPosOfDecl (DInterface { typarams, methods, ... }) =
  flatMap (returnPosMethod typarams) methods
returnPosOfDecl _ = []

returnPosMethod : List String -> IfaceMethod -> List String
returnPosMethod typarams (IfaceMethod mname mty _ _)
  | not (anyArgMentions (dispatchTyparams typarams) (methodArgs mty)) = [mname]
  | otherwise = []

-- The `ArgRw` hook that records nothing: every marker but the group-recursive one
-- (`markRecursiveOccurrences`) reads the dict application's route out of the goal
-- inference pushes for it, so it has nothing to do at mark time.
noDictHook : String -> EvId -> Unit
noDictHook _ _ = ()

-- Mint one dict-application node and tell the hook about it.
mintDictAt : ModuleCtx -> (String -> EvId -> Unit) -> String -> Expr
mintDictAt mctx onDict n =
  let ev = freshEvId mctx ()
  let _ = onDict n ev
  EDictAt n ev

-- rewrite a decl body with its own parameters seeded into the bound set.  Mirrors
-- desugar's mapDecl coverage exactly (DFunDef / DInterface / DImpl / DProp /
-- DTest / DAttrib; everything else — incl. DLetGroup — left unchanged),
-- so with the emit path off this would degenerate to the same node set mapProg
-- visits.
prePassDeclScoped : ModuleCtx -> ArgRw -> Decl -> Decl
prePassDeclScoped mctx rw (DFunDef pub n ps e site bid) =
  DFunDef
    pub
    n
    ps
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw (boundOfList (patVarsListTc ps)) e)
    site
    bid
prePassDeclScoped mctx rw (d@(DInterface { methods, ... })) =
  DInterface { d | methods = map (prePassIfaceMethodScoped mctx rw) methods }
prePassDeclScoped mctx rw (d@(DImpl { methods, ... })) =
  DImpl { d | methods = map (prePassImplMethodScoped mctx rw) methods }
prePassDeclScoped mctx rw (DProp pub name params body) =
  DProp
    pub
    name
    params
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw (boundOfList (propParamNamesTc params)) body)
prePassDeclScoped mctx rw (DTest pub name body) =
  DTest pub name (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw omEmpty body)
prePassDeclScoped mctx rw (DAttrib attrs d) =
  DAttrib attrs (prePassDeclScoped mctx rw d)
-- Top-level `let rec … with …` (DLetGroup): mapDecl/the catch-all skip its bodies,
-- so a constrained-fn occurrence inside a group body would never be rewritten to
-- EDictAt/EMethodAt → its call site gets no dict route → the dict-passed callee is
-- under-applied at eval.  Rewrite each clause body with that clause's params scoped
-- in, exactly like the DFunDef arm.
prePassDeclScoped mctx rw (DLetGroup pub binds) =
  DLetGroup pub (map (prePassLetBindScoped mctx rw) binds)
prePassDeclScoped mctx _ d = d

prePassLetBindScoped : ModuleCtx -> ArgRw -> LetBind -> LetBind
prePassLetBindScoped mctx rw (LetBind n clauses site bid) =
  LetBind n (map (prePassFunClauseScoped mctx rw) clauses) site bid

prePassFunClauseScoped : ModuleCtx -> ArgRw -> FunClause -> FunClause
prePassFunClauseScoped mctx rw (FunClause ps e) =
  FunClause ps (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw (boundOfList (patVarsListTc ps)) e)

prePassIfaceMethodScoped : ModuleCtx -> ArgRw -> IfaceMethod -> IfaceMethod
prePassIfaceMethodScoped mctx _ (IfaceMethod n ty None mloc) =
  IfaceMethod n ty None mloc
prePassIfaceMethodScoped mctx rw (IfaceMethod n ty (Some (MethodDefault ps e)) mloc) =
  IfaceMethod
    n
    ty
    (Some
      (MethodDefault
        ps
        (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw (boundOfList (patVarsListTc ps)) e)))
    mloc

prePassImplMethodScoped : ModuleCtx -> ArgRw -> ImplMethod -> ImplMethod
prePassImplMethodScoped mctx rw (ImplMethod n ps e) =
  ImplMethod n ps (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw (boundOfList (patVarsListTc ps)) e)

-- #1031: `bound` is an OrdMap-backed SET (name -> ()), not a `List String`
-- scanned by `contains` — a deep local nesting (N sequential lets, a reference
-- to an outer binding) made `contains n bound` an O(depth) scan per EVar,
-- O(depth²) over the body (the `scoperefs` shape).  `boundInsert`/`boundOfList`
-- extend it; membership is `omHasKey`.  A name maps to "" for an ordinary binder
-- and to the renamed binder for a candidate let binder (`letPatRename`).
boundInsert : List String -> OrdMap String -> OrdMap String
boundInsert [] b = b
boundInsert (n :: rest) b = boundInsert rest (omInsert n "" b)

-- A let binder that `isNonexpansive` may generalize: every such binder must be able
-- to take dictionary parameters, since generalizing one over a class predicate without
-- abstracting it would share one dictionary between uses at different types.  This
-- runs before inference, without the constructor table, so it over-approximates
-- `isCtorAppSpine` by the head's spelling alone.  A candidate that does not generalize
-- with predicates abstracts nothing and its uses stay plain variables.
localAbsCandidate : Expr -> Bool
localAbsCandidate (ELoc _ e) = localAbsCandidate e
localAbsCandidate (EDoOrigin _ e) = localAbsCandidate e
localAbsCandidate (EAnnot e _) = localAbsCandidate e
localAbsCandidate (EHeadAnnot e _) = localAbsCandidate e
localAbsCandidate (ELit _) = True
localAbsCandidate (EVar _) = True
localAbsCandidate (EVarId _ _) = True
localAbsCandidate (EMethodAt _ _ _) = True
localAbsCandidate (EDictAt _ _) = True
localAbsCandidate (EMethodRef _) = True
localAbsCandidate (ELam _ _) = True
localAbsCandidate (ETuple es) = allList localAbsCandidate es
localAbsCandidate (EListLit es) = allList localAbsCandidate es
localAbsCandidate (app@(EApp _ _)) = localAbsCtorSpine app
localAbsCandidate (ERecordCreate _ fs) =
  allList
    (fa => match fa
      FieldAssign _ e => localAbsCandidate e)
    fs
localAbsCandidate _ = False

localAbsCtorSpine : Expr -> Bool
localAbsCtorSpine (ELoc _ e) = localAbsCtorSpine e
localAbsCtorSpine (EDoOrigin _ e) = localAbsCtorSpine e
localAbsCtorSpine (EApp f x) = localAbsCtorSpine f && localAbsCandidate x
localAbsCtorSpine (EVar name) = ctorHeadShaped name
localAbsCtorSpine (EVarId name _) = ctorHeadShaped name
localAbsCtorSpine _ = False

localAbsCandidateBind : LetBind -> Bool
localAbsCandidateBind (LetBind _ clauses _ _) =
  anyList localAbsCandidateClause clauses

localAbsCandidateClause : FunClause -> Bool
localAbsCandidateClause (FunClause [] body) = localAbsCandidate body
localAbsCandidateClause (FunClause _ _) = True

-- A candidate let binder is renamed to a name no other binder carries, so the
-- binder and every occurrence of it name ONE binding for the rest of the pipeline;
-- the bound map sends the source name to the new one, and its occurrences are
-- marked `EDictAt` so a use can carry the dictionaries the binder abstracts.  A
-- name that is already one (a tree marked a second time) is an ordinary binder.
letPatRename : GraphCtx -> Pat -> Expr -> OrdMap String -> (Pat, OrdMap String)
letPatRename gctx (PVar x l bid) e1 b
  | localAbsCandidate e1 && not (isLocalAbsName x) =
    let fresh = freshLocalAbsName gctx x
    (PVar fresh l bid, omInsert x fresh b)
letPatRename gctx p _ b = (p, boundInsert (patVarsTc p) b)

bindsRename : GraphCtx ->
  List LetBind ->
  OrdMap String ->
  (List LetBind, OrdMap String)
bindsRename gctx [] b = ([], b)
bindsRename gctx ((bind@(LetBind n clauses site bid)) :: rest) b =
  let (n2, b1) =
    if localAbsCandidateBind bind && not (isLocalAbsName n) then
      let fresh = freshLocalAbsName gctx n
      (fresh, omInsert n fresh b)
    else
      (n, boundInsert [n] b)
  let (rest2, b2) = bindsRename gctx rest b1
  (LetBind n2 clauses site bid :: rest2, b2)

boundOfList : List String -> OrdMap String
boundOfList ns = boundInsert ns omEmpty

-- the core scope-threaded rewrite.  `bound` is the set of names in scope as
-- locals at this node.  At an EVar: the rp arm is scope-blind (unchanged); the
-- arg-position (`an`) and constrained-fn (`dn`) arms fire only when the name is
-- NOT shadowed by a local.  Binders
-- (ELam/ELet/ELetGroup/EMatch arms/EBlock/EDo + the where/do/guard
-- binders) extend `bound`; every other node recurses into its children with the
-- same `bound`.
rewriteArgScoped : ModuleCtx -> ArgRw -> OrdMap String -> Expr -> Expr
rewriteArgScoped mctx (ArgRw rp dn an sm onDict granted) bound (EVar n)
  -- P0-18: `n` is a MANGLED definer-shadow standalone (`<mid>__size`).  Mark it
  -- `EMethodAt` with the BARE dispatch name (so `implFor` finds the impl when the
  -- receiver has one) and seed the route's `RLocal <n>` fallback with the mangled
  -- symbol (so a no-impl receiver still reaches the standalone `@mdk_<mid>__size`).
  | omHasKey n bound = match omLookup n bound
    Some "" => EVar n
    Some renamed => EDictAt renamed (freshEvId mctx ())
    None => EVar n
  | otherwise = match lookupAssoc n sm
    Some bare => EMethodAt bare n (mintMethodCell mctx n)
    None =>
      if omHasKey n rp || omHasKey n an then
        EMethodAt n "" (mintMethodCell mctx "")
      else if omHasKey n dn then
        mintDictAt mctx onDict n
      else if granted n then
        mintGrantOnly mctx n
      else
        EVar n
-- A grant-only use of a member its group has just promoted becomes that member's
-- dictionary application, under the same id.
rewriteArgScoped mctx (ArgRw _ dn _ _ onDict _) _ (EDictAt n ev)
  | isGrantOnlyEv mctx.mcGraph ev && omHasKey n dn =
    let _ = unmarkGrantOnly mctx.mcGraph ev
    let _ = onDict n ev
    EDictAt n ev
  | otherwise = EDictAt n ev
-- No `EVarId` arm: every marker runs BEFORE resolve's binding-id stamp (the Flat
-- arm's whole-program pre-pass, and the schedule's per-group `markGroupClauses` →
-- `stampGroupClauses`), so a stamped occurrence never reaches this rewrite.
-- binders
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (ELam ps body) =
  ELam ps (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw (boundInsert (patVarsListTc ps) bound) body)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (ELet m r p e1 e2) =
  let (p2, after) = letPatRename mctx.mcGraph p e1 bound
  let b1 = if r then after else bound
  ELet
    m
    r
    p2
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw b1 e1)
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw after e2)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (ELetGroup binds e2) =
  let (binds2, bnd) = bindsRename mctx.mcGraph binds bound
  ELetGroup
    (map (rewriteArgLetBind mctx rw bnd) binds2)
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bnd e2)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (EMatch e0 arms) =
  EMatch
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e0)
    (map (rewriteArgArm mctx rw bound) arms)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (EBlock stmts) =
  EBlock (rewriteArgStmts mctx rw bound stmts)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (EDo d stmts) =
  EDo d (rewriteArgStmts mctx rw bound stmts)
-- non-binder composites: recurse children with the same bound
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (ELoc l e) =
  ELoc l (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (EDoOrigin l e) =
  EDoOrigin l (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (EApp f x) =
  EApp (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound f) (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound x)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (EIf c t e) =
  EIf
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound c)
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound t)
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e)
-- An operator site is minted once: `markRecursiveOccurrences` re-marks bodies
-- inference already wrote through these ids, so a minted id passes through.
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (EBinOp op l r ev) =
  let l2 = rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound l
  let r2 = rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound r
  EBinOp op l2 r2 (mintedOr (mintOpSite mctx) ev)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (EUnOp op x ev) =
  let x2 = rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound x
  EUnOp op x2 (mintedOr (mintOpSite mctx) ev)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (EInfix op l r) =
  EInfix
    op
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound l)
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound r)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (EFieldAccess e0 n ev) =
  EFieldAccess
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e0)
    n
    (mintedOr (mintHeadSite mctx) ev)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (ETuple es) =
  ETuple (map (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound) es)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (EListLit es) =
  EListLit (map (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound) es)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (EArrayLit es) =
  EArrayLit (map (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound) es)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (ERangeList lo hi i) =
  ERangeList
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound lo)
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound hi)
    i
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (ERangeArray lo hi i) =
  ERangeArray
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound lo)
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound hi)
    i
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (ESlice e0 lo hi i) =
  ESlice
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e0)
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound lo)
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound hi)
    i
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (EIndex e0 i) =
  EIndex (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e0) (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound i)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (EAnnot e0 t) =
  EAnnot (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e0) t
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (EHeadAnnot e0 t) =
  EHeadAnnot (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e0) t
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (ERecordCreate n fs) =
  ERecordCreate n (map (rewriteArgField mctx rw bound) fs)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (ERecordUpdate e0 fs ev) =
  ERecordUpdate
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e0)
    (map (rewriteArgField mctx rw bound) fs)
    (mintedOr (mintHeadSite mctx) ev)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (EVariantUpdate c e0 fs) =
  EVariantUpdate
    c
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e0)
    (map (rewriteArgField mctx rw bound) fs)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (EStringInterp parts) =
  EStringInterp (map (rewriteArgInterp mctx rw bound) parts)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (EGuards arms) =
  EGuards (map (rewriteArgGuardArm mctx rw bound) arms)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (ESection (SecRight op e0)) =
  ESection (SecRight op (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e0))
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (ESection (SecLeft e0 op)) =
  ESection (SecLeft (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e0) op)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (EMapLit n kvs) =
  EMapLit n (map (rewriteArgKv mctx rw bound) kvs)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (ESetLit n es) =
  ESetLit n (map (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound) es)
rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound (EAsPat x sub) =
  EAsPat x (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound sub)
-- Numeric literals carry a site id that is minted here, like operators.
rewriteArgScoped mctx _ _ (ENumLit n ev lx) =
  ENumLit n (mintedOr (mintLitSite mctx) ev) lx
rewriteArgScoped mctx _ _ (EWideLit hi lo ev lx) =
  EWideLit hi lo (mintedOr (mintOpSite mctx) ev) lx
-- leaves (ELit / EMethodRef / EDictApp / EVarAt / EMethodAt / EDictAt / SecBare)
rewriteArgScoped mctx _ _ e = e

rewriteArgField : ModuleCtx ->
  ArgRw ->
  OrdMap String ->
  FieldAssign ->
  FieldAssign
rewriteArgField mctx rw bound (FieldAssign n e) =
  FieldAssign n (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e)

rewriteArgKv : ModuleCtx ->
  ArgRw ->
  OrdMap String ->
  (Expr, Expr) ->
  (Expr, Expr)
rewriteArgKv mctx rw bound (k, v) =
  (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound k, rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound v)

rewriteArgInterp : ModuleCtx ->
  ArgRw ->
  OrdMap String ->
  InterpPart ->
  InterpPart
rewriteArgInterp mctx _ _ (InterpStr s) = InterpStr s
rewriteArgInterp mctx rw bound (InterpExpr e) =
  InterpExpr (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e)

rewriteArgLetBind : ModuleCtx -> ArgRw -> OrdMap String -> LetBind -> LetBind
rewriteArgLetBind mctx rw bound (LetBind n clauses site bid) =
  LetBind n (map (rewriteArgFunClause mctx rw bound) clauses) site bid

rewriteArgFunClause : ModuleCtx ->
  ArgRw ->
  OrdMap String ->
  FunClause ->
  FunClause
rewriteArgFunClause mctx rw bound (FunClause ps body) =
  FunClause
    ps
    (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw (boundInsert (patVarsListTc ps) bound) body)

-- a match/function arm: the pattern binds for the guards + body; a `| p <- e`
-- guard binds for later guards + the body (threaded left-to-right).
rewriteArgArm : ModuleCtx -> ArgRw -> OrdMap String -> Arm -> Arm
rewriteArgArm mctx rw bound (Arm p gs body) =
  let b0 = boundInsert (patVarsTc p) bound
  let (gs2, bnd) = rewriteArgGuards mctx rw b0 gs
  Arm p gs2 (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bnd body)

rewriteArgGuardArm : ModuleCtx -> ArgRw -> OrdMap String -> GuardArm -> GuardArm
rewriteArgGuardArm mctx rw bound (GuardArm gs body) =
  let (gs2, bnd) = rewriteArgGuards mctx rw bound gs
  GuardArm gs2 (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bnd body)

rewriteArgGuards : ModuleCtx ->
  ArgRw ->
  OrdMap String ->
  List Guard ->
  (List Guard, OrdMap String)
rewriteArgGuards mctx _ bound [] = ([], bound)
rewriteArgGuards mctx rw bound ((GBool e) :: rest) =
  let e2 = rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e
  let (rest2, bnd) = rewriteArgGuards mctx rw bound rest
  (GBool e2 :: rest2, bnd)
rewriteArgGuards mctx rw bound ((GBind p e) :: rest) =
  let e2 = rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e
  let (rest2, bnd) =
    rewriteArgGuards mctx rw (boundInsert (patVarsTc p) bound) rest
  (GBind p e2 :: rest2, bnd)

-- do/block statements: a DoBind/DoLet pattern binds for SUBSEQUENT
-- statements (a recursive DoLet also for its own RHS).
rewriteArgStmts : ModuleCtx ->
  ArgRw ->
  OrdMap String ->
  List DoStmt ->
  List DoStmt
rewriteArgStmts mctx _ _ [] = []
rewriteArgStmts mctx rw bound ((DoExpr e) :: rest) =
  DoExpr (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e)
    :: rewriteArgStmts mctx rw bound rest
rewriteArgStmts mctx rw bound ((DoBind p e) :: rest) =
  DoBind p (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e)
    :: rewriteArgStmts mctx rw (boundInsert (patVarsTc p) bound) rest
rewriteArgStmts mctx rw bound ((DoLet m r p e site) :: rest) =
  let (p2, after) = letPatRename mctx.mcGraph p e bound
  let b1 = if r then after else bound
  DoLet m r p2 (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw b1 e) site
    :: rewriteArgStmts mctx rw after rest
rewriteArgStmts mctx rw bound ((DoAssign x e) :: rest) =
  DoAssign x (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e)
    :: rewriteArgStmts mctx rw bound rest
rewriteArgStmts mctx rw bound ((DoFieldAssign x fs e) :: rest) =
  DoFieldAssign x fs (rewriteArgScoped mctx rw bound e)
    :: rewriteArgStmts mctx rw bound rest

-- interface methods carrying a method-level constraint (a `=>` in the method's own
-- signature over any tyvar, e.g. foldMap's `Monoid m`) — rewritten to EMethodAt
-- alongside the return-position methods so the method-level dict can be folded on.
-- Computed structurally before `checkBodyImpl` populates `methodPredicateSlotsRef`.
methodConstraintNames : List Decl -> List String
methodConstraintNames prog = flatMap methodConstraintNamesOfDecl prog

methodConstraintNamesOfDecl : Decl -> List String
methodConstraintNamesOfDecl (DAttrib _ d) = methodConstraintNamesOfDecl d
methodConstraintNamesOfDecl (DInterface { typarams, methods, ... }) =
  flatMap (methodConstraintNameOf typarams) methods
methodConstraintNamesOfDecl _ = []

methodConstraintNameOf : List String -> IfaceMethod -> List String
methodConstraintNameOf typarams (IfaceMethod mname mty _ _)
  | hasMethodLevelConstraint typarams mty = [mname]
  | otherwise = []

-- does this method type carry a leading `=>` constraint over some tyvar? (a
-- method-LEVEL constraint: the method's own context, as opposed to an impl `requires`)
hasMethodLevelConstraint : List String -> Ty -> Bool
hasMethodLevelConstraint typarams (TyConstrained cs t) =
  constraintsHaveMethodLevel typarams cs || hasMethodLevelConstraint typarams t
hasMethodLevelConstraint typarams (TyEffect _ _ t) =
  hasMethodLevelConstraint typarams t
hasMethodLevelConstraint _ _ = False

constraintsHaveMethodLevel : List String -> List Constraint -> Bool
constraintsHaveMethodLevel _ [] = False
constraintsHaveMethodLevel typarams (c :: rest) =
  constraintIsMethodLevel typarams c || constraintsHaveMethodLevel typarams rest

resolveSites : SiteCtx -> OrdMap Unit -> List PendingEntry -> Unit
resolveSites sx _ [] = ()
resolveSites sx rpNames ((PendingEntry name tagRef resultMono encl kind loc scope _) :: rest) =
  let sx = { sx | sxSite = loc }
  let _ = match kind
    SKReturn implRef fullMono =>
      resolveSite
        sx
        rpNames
        name
        tagRef
        implRef
        resultMono
        fullMono
        encl
        loc
        scope
    SKAdmittedReturn ifaceRef implRef fullMono =>
      resolveAdmittedSite sx name ifaceRef tagRef implRef fullMono encl scope
    SKExactReturn implRef request =>
      resolveExactReturnSite
        sx
        rpNames
        name
        tagRef
        implRef
        resultMono
        request
        encl
        loc
        scope
    SKNumReturn predicate fullMono =>
      resolveNumLitSite
        sx
        rpNames
        name
        tagRef
        resultMono
        fullMono
        predicate
        encl
        loc
        scope
    _ => ()
  resolveSites sx rpNames rest

-- a method occurrence's route: if its discriminating type is a constrained
-- function's constraint variable, read that function's dict param (RDict);
-- otherwise the selected impl's key (RKey); an unresolved polymorphic type
-- stays RNone.  When the route resolves to a concrete head
-- that names a parametric impl WITH a `requires`, also fill the impl-dicts ref so
-- eval threads the element dict(s) into the impl body (Phase 83/84 single-level).
-- Phase 83/84 #5: stamp the route for one pending method site.  At a concrete
-- result type (ground RKey case) the element dict routes are computed recursively
-- by implDictRoutesFor.  At a polymorphic result type (RDict case) the route is
-- RDictFwd for return-position methods — eval will extract and forward the
-- enclosing VDict's nested requires at runtime.  Arg-position methods (display/==)
-- stay RDict; their VMulti dispatch is by arg-tag, not by the forwarded reqs.
-- TYPECHECK-AUDIT C7: the ground RKey case prefers the canonical impl KEY (via
-- keyForSite) over the bare head tycon, so two non-overlapping impls sharing a
-- head tycon (Pair Int Bool vs Pair Bool Int) route to distinct keys; eval's
-- narrowMethod then matches the right VTypedImpl by its key field.  No selected
-- row → no route (`RNone`).
-- C5 NOTE: standalone-shadow RLocal routing is NOT done here — a return-position
-- site keys off the RESULT mono (`isEmpty`'s `Bool`), which never names the receiver's
-- impl, so this gate would mis-route every shadow method.  RLocal is stamped by the
-- arg-position resolveRLocalSites (keyed on the RECEIVER mono) AFTER resolveSites.
resolveSite : SiteCtx ->
  OrdMap Unit ->
  String ->
  Ref Route ->
  Ref (List Route) ->
  Mono ->
  Mono ->
  String ->
  Option Loc ->
  ScopeId ->
  Unit
-- #156 S3b: a thin adapter over `entail` (EKReturn kind).  `entail` returns
-- `(primaryRoute, elementRoutes)`; stamp them into (tagRef, implRef).  Reproduces the
-- pre-S3b arm-by-arm body: assum → `(RDictFwd/RDict, [])`, inst → `(RKey key [],
-- selected-row prerequisite routes)`, fallback → `(RNone, [])`.
-- ⚠️ tagRef is NOT always RNone-seeded: a P0-18 standalone-shadow site seeds it to
-- `RLocal <sym> []` at rewriteArgScoped (~7438).  A return-position standalone value
-- shadow is then force-stamped `RLocal` by `resolveRLocalSites`; an argument-position
-- importer shadow is the separate receiver-sensitive case described at `resolveArgStamp`.
-- The pre-S3b None arm's `()` was load-bearing: it PRESERVED that RLocal seed.  For
-- EKReturn `entail` yields RNone ONLY from its fallback (assum→RDict/RDictFwd, inst→RKey),
